item.title: Make My Photo Look Professional

turns.text: Make me look professional in this photo.

item.tests: Uses reasonable defaults for a vague professional portrait request without unnecessary clarification.
must_haves: The portrait shows the same man, retaining his short grey hair and recognisable facial features.
His casual T-shirt is replaced with professional clothing such as a collared shirt or blazer.
The kitchen setting is replaced or simplified into an unobtrusive professional backdrop.
Harsh facial lighting is softened while retaining realistic skin texture.
The result is a clean head-and-shoulders portrait without visible editing artifacts.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Transform this photo into a polished, photorealistic professional business headshot of the exact same man. Preserve his facial identity, age, facial features, short gray hair, natural skin texture and light stubble. Keep his direct gaze and head-and-shoulders composition. Replace the casual gray T-shirt with a well-tailored navy blazer over a crisp light blue open-collar business shirt. Replace the kitchen with a clean softly blurred neutral gray studio background. Use flattering soft professional portrait lighting, balanced exposure, natural skin tones and sharp eyes. Maintain a natural approachable expression, subtly relaxed without changing facial features. Realistic corporate profile photograph, no text, no excessive retouching.
